regionalModel: Metropolitan French reference; regional variants require review

lessons.title: Read x in words, numbers, and names
lessons.objective: Read x as /ks/ or /gz/ in selected words, confirm a person's name pronunciation, and compare its behavior in deux and dix.
lessons.focus: Compare /ks/ in taxi and Alex with /gz/ in exact. Ask how Xavier pronounces his own name rather than inferring it from the spelling. Final x is silent in deux. Dix has /s/ in isolation, but its final sound changes with the following word.

words.fr: Le taxi arrive dans dix minutes.
words.en: The taxi arrives in ten minutes.

words.fr: Alex et Xavier attendent devant la gare.
words.en: Alex and Xavier are waiting in front of the station.

words.fr: J'ai deux adresses sur mon téléphone.
words.en: I have two addresses on my phone.

words.fr: Voici l'endroit exact sur la carte.
words.en: Here is the exact place on the map.

reader.fr: Alex attend Xavier devant la gare avec deux valises.
reader.en: Alex waits for Xavier in front of the station with two suitcases.

reader.fr: Le taxi arrive dans dix minutes, mais le chauffeur demande l'adresse exacte.
reader.en: The taxi arrives in ten minutes, but the driver asks for the exact address.

reader.fr: Xavier montre l'endroit sur la carte de son téléphone.
reader.en: Xavier shows the place on the map on his phone.

reader.fr: Alex confirme l'adresse et ils montent dans le taxi.
reader.en: Alex confirms the address and they get into the taxi.

speaking.scene: Giving a taxi driver the exact station pickup address
speaking.opening: Bonjour, Alex et Xavier attendent devant la gare.
goals: Say that two passengers are waiting.
Confirm whether the taxi arrives in ten minutes.
speaking.closure: Merci, voici l'endroit exact sur la carte.

see.prompt: Find /ks/ in taxi and Alex, /gz/ in exact, then compare final x in deux and dix; ask how Xavier says his name.

recall.prompt: Recall the French phrase for 'the exact place' before revealing it.
recall.answerRef: Voici l'endroit exact sur la carte.

hear.prompt: Listen for taxi or exact in the recorded station phrase and compare the x sound.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The taxi arrives in ten minutes.'
type.answerRef: Le taxi arrive dans dix minutes.

say.prompt: Tell the driver that Alex and Xavier are waiting in front of the station.
say.answerRef: Alex et Xavier attendent devant la gare.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences giving the two passengers' names and the exact pickup place.

lessons.title: Hear spoken and silent final consonants
lessons.objective: Contrast selected audible final consonants with silent ones in a market purchase and pickup request.
lessons.focus: Hear the final consonant in sac, avec, and neuf; compare silent written endings in grand, petit, and trop. These examples are word-specific models, not a rule that every final letter of the same kind behaves alike.

words.fr: Le petit sac est trop plein.
words.en: The small bag is too full.
I am coming with nine books.

reader.fr: Au marché du livre, je demande un grand sac pour mes achats.
reader.en: At the book market, I ask for a large bag for my purchases.

reader.fr: Le vendeur me donne d'abord un petit sac, mais il est trop plein.
reader.en: The seller first gives me a small bag, but it is too full.

reader.fr: Je repars avec neuf livres dans un sac plus grand.
reader.en: I leave with nine books in a larger bag.

reader.fr: Le vendeur me dit que ce sac est neuf.
reader.en: The seller tells me that this bag is new.

speaking.scene: Choosing a bag for books at a market
speaking.opening: Bonjour, je viens avec neuf livres à emporter.
goals: Explain why the small bag is too full.
Confirm that the replacement bag is new.
speaking.closure: Merci, je prends ce grand sac.

see.prompt: Mark the heard final consonant in sac, avec, neuf and the silent written ending in grand, petit, trop.

recall.prompt: Recall the French phrase for 'the small bag is too full' before revealing it.
recall.answerRef: Le petit sac est trop plein.

hear.prompt: Listen for grand or sac in the recorded book-market phrase.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'This bag is new.'

say.prompt: Tell the bookseller that you will take a large bag.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences about the small bag and the nine books.

lessons.title: Begin French s clusters without an extra vowel
lessons.objective: Start French sp and st clusters directly in a sports-center conversation without inserting a vowel before /s/.
lessons.focus: Begin sport, spécial, spectacle with /sp/ and stade, station, style with /st/. The first sound is /s/; do not add an initial vowel while moving into the next consonant.

words.fr: Nous faisons du sport au stade.
words.en: We play sports at the stadium.

words.fr: La station est près du stade.
words.en: The station is near the stadium.

words.fr: Ce spectacle a un style spécial.
words.en: This show has a special style.

words.fr: Je vais au stade après le spectacle.
words.en: I am going to the stadium after the show.

reader.fr: Nous sortons de la station et marchons vers le stade.
reader.en: We leave the station and walk toward the stadium.

reader.fr: Un spectacle de danse commence avant le match de football.
reader.en: A dance show starts before the football match.

reader.fr: Le groupe a un style spécial que tout le monde remarque.
reader.en: The group has a special style that everyone notices.

reader.fr: Après le spectacle, nous entrons dans le stade pour voir le match.
reader.en: After the show, we enter the stadium to watch the match.

speaking.scene: Finding a performance and a match near a stadium
speaking.opening: Bonjour, la station est-elle près du stade ?
goals: Say you will go into the stadium after the show.
speaking.closure: Merci, je vais au stade après le spectacle.

see.prompt: Group sport, spécial, spectacle by /sp/ and stade, station, style by /st/; keep /s/ at word start.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for station before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for station or spectacle in the recorded event sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The station is near the stadium.'
type.answerRef: La station est près du stade.

say.prompt: Tell the attendant you will go to the stadium after the show.
say.answerRef: Je vais au stade après le spectacle.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences linking the station, the show, and the stadium.
